description.value: Pizzeria Antico is Whistler's only Neapolitan pizza restaurant, serving wood-fired pies alongside fresh house-made pastas, with all dough, sauces, fior di latte, ricotta, and bread made daily in-house. Located in the Apenglow Lodge on Main Street, it pours 18 BC craft beer taps and 8 BC wine taps, making it a strong showcase of local producers. A semi-private dining area accommodates larger groups, and the rustic casual setting suits post-ride refuelling.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides the primary evidence. The about page confirms this is a full-service sit-down Neapolitan pizza restaurant in Whistler with an online ordering option (takeout implied by 'ONLINE ORDERING' nav item). The menu pages show several explicitly vegetarian dishes (Margherita, Ortolana, Ruccola con Limone, Monte Bianco pasta). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed cannot verify OSM agreement.
Postal code on website shows 'V2V 000', which appears to be a placeholder rather than a real postal code — the real code should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established full-service restaurant on Whistler's Main Street with online ordering, a substantial lunch and dinner menu, and strong local beer and wine selection — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through Whistler.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian options visible on both lunch and dinner menus: Margherita pizza (tomato, fior di latte, basil), Ortolana pizza (oven roasted mixed vegetables, fior di latte), Ruccola con Limone salad (arugula, lemon vinaigrette), and Monte Bianco pasta (oven roasted vegetables, tomato sauce, ricotta). No explicit vegan or GF labelling found
